description: When your best friends are covered in fur, you get used to finding their hair everywhere — including in your morning coffee! Cat owners agree they wouldn’t have it any other way, though. Makes the perfect holiday or birthday gift for cat lovers. This 16 oz., high-quality stoneware mug is dishwasher and microwave safe. Securely packaged in decorative gift box.
